verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents a REST API and points to an open-source Python module with scripts and templates, for example to export session data. That module is the closest thing to an official SDK, but the docs present it as a set of helper scripts, not a supported, versioned client library. The CLI and the raw REST API are adjacent automation surfaces, not SDKs, and no OpenAPI spec was found to generate clients from. Missing for 10: clearly official, maintained SDKs in multiple languages, SDK reference documentation, an OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on evidence of building against the SDK.
